title: Conditional Projection GAN on Overlapping Classes
intuition: Evaluates class-conditional generation with a Projection Discriminator on 4 overlapping 2D Gaussian classes (sigma=0.35), specifically checking that within-class variance and central overlap density (>= 0.55) are preserved.
failure_mode: Conditioned critics push classes artificially apart to make classification easier, hollowing out the true central overlap region (overlap_density_ratio < 0.55) and shrinking per-class variance.
